title: My profile
subtitle: Your user profile and account details.
detailsHint: Contact an administrator to change these details.

security.title: Security
security.description: You can change your password yourself. After the change, sign-ins on other devices are ended.
security.hint: At least 12 characters. Do not use your login, PINFL or date of birth.
security.forcedText: The administrator gave you a temporary password. To continue, set a new password that only you know.

errors.short: The new password must be 12 to 128 characters.
errors.mismatch: The new password and its confirmation do not match.
errors.same: The new password must differ from the current one.
